sourceTitle: Travels in Arabia; comprehending an account of those territories in Hedjaz which the Mohammedans regard as sacred
description: "Travels in Arabia" by John Lewis Burckhardt is a historical account written in the early 19th century. This work documents the author’s journey through the Hedjaz region of Arabia, detailing the sacred territories revered by Muslims, including the cities of Mekka (Mecca) and Medina.
